message.content: The sea usually looks **blue**—often described as a deep azure or turquoise hue—but its exact shade varies. In shallow waters it may appear more greenish‑blue due to algae and plant life; deeper parts tend toward darker blues. Light scattering, water clarity, and even weather conditions all influence how we perceive the ocean’s color.
